title: Baiju Bhatt on New Company, Plans for Data Centers in Space
text: Baiju Bhatt, Cowboy Space’s Founder and CEO, says the company is developing an energy grid in orbit. Its first satellite, Reason 1, reached orbit on a SpaceX rideshare, and the team has made contact and is communicating with it daily. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)
